focus_areas: Texture consistency of the checkered grip on the central lighter

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the central lighter's grip pattern. AI often struggles with repeating geometric patterns on curved surfaces, leading to warping or melting textures. Also, verify if the clear plastic packaging around the central lighter exhibits realistic refraction and highlights, or if it blends unnaturally with the background (fusion artifact). Check the right lighter for structural rigidity; disposable lighters should have sharp, straight edges.
